summary.goal: Wire ideation package to read IdeationConfig from Tuner and use it for model selection, confidence calibration, specialist spawning, and readiness advisory. Emit IdeationOutcome on handoff.

acceptance_criteria.description: Interviewer LLM config (model, max_tokens, temperature) driven by IdeationConfig with fallback to current hardcoded defaults
Confidence mapping (exploring/forming/confident values) driven by IdeationConfig.confidence_calibration
On session start, early_spawn_rules checked against initial_intent keywords; matching specialists spawned proactively
Deprioritized specialists show advisory note in spawn tool response but are NOT hard-blocked
send_to_planner tool response includes readiness advisory warnings when thresholds not met (conversation turns, specialist coverage, curated blocks)
Readiness warnings are ADVISORY only — handoff is never blocked
IdeationOutcome emitted to Tuner after every successful handoff to Planner (fire-and-forget)
Handoff succeeds even when Tuner is unreachable
All behaviors fall back to current hardcoded defaults when Tuner is down

steps.title: Initialize IdeationIntegration in ideation package
steps.description: In packages/ideation/src/index.ts or server.ts, initialize IdeationIntegration and pass config callback to InterviewerService

acceptance_criteria.description: import { IdeationIntegration } from '@planner/tuner';
const tunerIntegration = new IdeationIntegration({ tunerUrl: process.env.TUNER_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4002' });
await tunerIntegration.initialize();
Pass tunerConfig: () => tunerIntegration.getConfig() to InterviewerService constructor

steps.title: Replace hardcoded LLM config with tuner-driven config
steps.description: Modify packages/ideation/src/interviewer/config.ts to export getInterviewerLLMConfig(tunerConfig?) function instead of const LLM_CONFIG

acceptance_criteria.description: export const LLM_DEFAULTS = { model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514', maxTokens: 4096, temperature: 0.7 };
export function getInterviewerLLMConfig(tunerConfig?: IdeationConfig) { if (!tunerConfig) return LLM_DEFAULTS; return { model: tunerConfig.interviewer.model, ... }; }
InterviewerService calls getInterviewerLLMConfig(this.tunerConfig()) when making Anthropic API calls

architecture.pattern: Function replaces const, accepts tuner config

steps.title: Replace hardcoded confidence mapping with tuner-driven mapping

acceptance_criteria.description: export const CONFIDENCE_DEFAULTS = { exploring: 25, forming: 50, confident: 90 };
export function getConfidenceMap(tunerConfig?: IdeationConfig) { if (!tunerConfig) return CONFIDENCE_DEFAULTS; return { exploring: tunerConfig.confidence_calibration.exploring_value, ... }; }
Confidence computation functions receive tunerConfig parameter

architecture.pattern: Function replaces const, accepts tuner config

steps.title: Implement early spawn rules on session start
steps.description: In packages/ideation/src/interviewer/service.ts, after session creation, check early_spawn_rules from tuner config and spawn matching specialists

acceptance_criteria.description: After session created, before first Interviewer response, check config.specialist_spawning.early_spawn_rules
For each rule, check if rule.topic_signals.some(signal => initial_intent.toLowerCase().includes(signal.toLowerCase()))
If match, spawn rule.specialists not in deprioritized list
Spawning is additive — Interviewer can still spawn others on-demand

architecture.pattern: Proactive spawning based on learned patterns

steps.title: Add deprioritized specialist advisory
steps.description: In specialist spawn tool executor, check deprioritized list and include advisory note in tool response

acceptance_criteria.description: When Interviewer invokes spawn_specialist tool, check config.specialist_spawning.deprioritized
If specialist in deprioritized, add note: 'Note: {specialist} has had low contribution rates in recent sessions.'
Specialist is still spawned (NOT blocked)
Interviewer sees note, can relay to user or override

steps.title: Add readiness advisory to send_to_planner tool
steps.description: In send_to_planner tool executor, check readiness advisory thresholds and include warnings in tool response when not met

acceptance_criteria.description: Check session.transcript.length < advisory.min_conversation_turns
Check session.active_specialists.length < advisory.min_specialist_coverage
Check curatedBlocks.length < advisory.min_curated_blocks
For each unmet threshold, add warning to tool response
Warnings are ADVISORY only — handoff still proceeds
Interviewer sees warnings in tool response, can relay to user

steps.title: Emit IdeationOutcome on handoff
steps.description: In packages/ideation/src/api/handlers.ts (sendToPlanner handler), emit IdeationOutcome to Tuner after successful planner handoff

acceptance_criteria.description: After successful planner response, call tunerIntegration.recordIdeationOutcome({ ... })

IdeationOutcome includes: session_id, plan_id, session_duration_seconds, conversation_turns, specialists_spawned, specialist_contributions, blocks_total, blocks_curated, blocks_user_edited, avg_block_confidence, is_first_send, send_number, understanding_field_count
Fire-and-forget: .catch(() => {}) to never fail handoff
Handoff succeeds even when Tuner is unreachable

steps.title: Build buildSpecialistContributions helper
steps.description: Create helper function to build specialist_contributions object from session data

acceptance_criteria.description: Iterates session.active_specialists
For each specialist, counts observations_count, insights_queued, blocks_created
Gets final_confidence from specialist observation
Returns Record<string, SpecialistContribution>

architecture.pattern: Helper function for outcome data assembly

steps.title: Verify fallback behavior
steps.description: Integration tests verifying ideation works identically with defaults when Tuner is unreachable

acceptance_criteria.description: With TUNER_URL unset or Tuner down, ideation starts successfully
Interviewer uses LLM_DEFAULTS (model, temperature, maxTokens)
Confidence values use CONFIDENCE_DEFAULTS
No early spawn rules fire (empty list)
No deprioritized advisories (empty list)
No readiness warnings (default thresholds allow everything)
Handoff succeeds, IdeationOutcome emission fails silently
